description: This file defines a React component 'SessionsByOrganization' that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by organization name, using the 'recharts' library. It includes internal functions for label truncation and a custom tooltip, and references external theme and color modules.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Truncates a label string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a custom tooltip for the chart, displaying the organization name and session count.
